blocks.x: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation for Property & Casualty — digital workers, decision hubs and self-healing workflows — governed autonomy at enterprise scale applied to the property & casualty operating unit of Insurance & Risk.

P&C economics live in two moments: pricing the risk before the event and handling the claim after it. Both are decision factories — rate against exposure and catastrophe models, settle against policy language and fraud signals — and both reward carriers whose document and data machinery is industrialized.

items: FNOL, estimates, medical and police files arrive as documents; triage takes days and leakage hides in the queue.
Telematics and GLM pricing outrun validation and filing capacity; model risk documentation is rebuilt under exam.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Hyperautomation & Systems Integration, Decision Intelligence Systems, Process & Task Mining from the Agentic AI & Hyperautomation tower, wired into the unit's workflows (FNOL and claims triage, Estimate review and leakage control, Commercial risk surveying) on Achala Swarm and Achala Nexus and Achala Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — Rate filing regimes among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Agents that execute the work — tool-using, policy-bounded, and replayable for audit.
Hundreds of agents as one governed fleet — roles, queues, budgets and audit for the AI workforce.
Enterprise decisions in milliseconds — decision hubs with policy, evidence and replay built in.
documents classified/extracted; straight-through for clean claims with audit replay (triage in minutes)
